hook: He was 89, and his car was going under with him inside.
narration: An eighty-nine-year-old man was sinking inside his car.
It went into the water at St. Andrews Marina, in Panama City, Florida.
A Coast Guard cutter crew saw it go in. Their boat crew arrived two minutes later.
Water pins a car door shut, so rescuers go in through the window.
[short pause] They broke the glass and pulled him out.
outcome: The boat crew rescued the eighty-nine-year-old, and the car sank behind them.
title: Man, 89, trapped in a sinking car
description:
A Coast Guard boat crew from Coast Guard Cutter Marlin broke a car's window and rescued an 89-year-old man after his vehicle went into St. Andrews Marina in Panama City, Florida, on Dec. 30, 2017.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Cutter Marlin, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/578149/coast-guard-rescues-man-sinking-car
